name: Stress Testing Image Watermarks
description: A task to evaluate the robustness of invisible watermarks embedded in AI-generated images through large-scale stress testing, using both black-box and beige-box attack tracks.

cr:input.name: ETI Benchmark Dataset
cr:input.description: A dataset of AI-generated images with watermarks applied using in-processing and post-processing techniques. Includes 907 images for the Black-box track and 300 images for the Beige-box track, with watermarks such as Gaussian Shading, StegaStamp, JigMark, PRC, StableSignature, and Trufo.
cr:input.encodingFormat: [FILL IN THE BLANK: dataset encoding format]
cr:input.contentUrl: [FILL IN THE BLANK: dataset download URL]

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: Predictions indicating the success of watermark removal and the preservation of image quality. Outputs include metrics for watermark detection rates and image quality degradation.

field.name: watermark_detection_rate
field.description: The proportion of images where the watermark remains detectable after the attack. Example: 0.15 (15% detection rate).

field.name: image_quality_degradation
field.description: A normalized score representing the visual degradation of the image after the attack. Example: 0.05 (low degradation).

cr:evaluation.notes: The primary metric is the Euclidean distance of Q (image quality degradation) and A (watermark detection performance). Lower values indicate better performance. A is defined as TPR@0.1%FPR.
